description: This file contains utility functions and scripts related to system upgrade processes for embedded devices or Linux-based systems. It includes functions for installing files, managing hooks, handling disk images, parsing partition tables, and performing upgrades via MTD. The code also includes system introspection functions for device detection and magic number identification.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies and links files into the RAM_ROOT directory, handling symbolic links and regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs a binary file and its linked libraries into the RAM_ROOT.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a series of functions passed as arguments with a specified argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no response with a default option.

methods.name: _v
methods.description: Logs verbose messages when verbosity is enabled.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs an info message with timestamp and tags.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in JSON.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads a file or image, possibly decompressing it based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Streams an image through dd with verbose filtering.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads a magic word from an image.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic identifier from an image.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Retrieves GPT partition signature.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Retrieves VFAT FAT signature.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Retrieves FAT32 signature.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies the file type based on magic number.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition signature.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 partition signature.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies the device corresponding to the boot root partition.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports the device name of a partition based on major/minor number.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit little-endian hex string to CPU format.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads and parses the partition table of a disk device.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade is in progress.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade via MTD, optionally handling backups.
